senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; שָׁרָה)infusion; steeping; משְׁרַת ענבים infusion of grapes.
units: Pes. 44ᵃ האי משרת וכ׳ this additional specification of mishrath (Num. VI, 3) &c.; a. e.—
<cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 6:25">Tosef. Shebi. VI, 25</cite>, v. <cite ref="K00053"><he>כְּבִיסָה</he></cite>.—

B. Kam. 102ᵃ, a. e. לאכלה ולא למ׳ you may use the products of the Sabbatical year ‘for eating’ (Lev. XXV, 6), but not as substances for steeping, v. מְלוּגְמָא; a. fr.—Esp. a pond for steeping flax &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 2:10">B. Bath. II, 10</cite> <he>מרחיקין את המ׳ וכ׳</he> you must keep your pond removed from your neighbor’s vegetable garden &c.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 18b:8">Ib. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ וירקא</he> the legal distance between a pond and your neighbor’s vegetable garden; a. e.
